Minimalist flat line-art with thick dark gray/black strokes and a few yellow accent marks, no real photo, like a modern infographic PNG with transparency. Overall composition: left side has a padlocked box/container, a stick-figure person climbing/leaping out and running toward the right, drawing a bold yellow path/arrow that goes straight to a large yellow “X” on the right; behind and around it is a desaturated light-gray maze-like dotted/blocked winding path with arrows (a complicated route) contrasting with the shortcut. No text anywhere. 

Human subject: a simple stick-figure person (gender-neutral, no face details, white circular head with dark outline, monochrome stick limbs) in a dynamic running/escaping pose. The figure is mid-stride with one leg stepping out of the box and the other leg forward, one arm bent forward and one back, as if sprinting. Small yellow accent “action” marks near the head/shoulder to indicate motion or excitement/alertness. Thick dark charcoal/black line for the body, no clothing, no skin details (white head circle), clean icon style.

Objects and attributes: left bottom/mid-left a 3D-ish isometric rectangular box/containment crate with thick dark outlines, the lid open and tilted up/back, with motion streaks/curved lines showing the figure climbing out; the box is light gray/white panels with dark outlines, and a large padlock icon on the front face (dark lock body with keyhole) indicating it is locked/constrained. The lid is open (angled) and the stick figure is emerging/leaping out over the edge, with small curved escape/motion lines behind the figure’s hip/leg area. The figure’s feet/leg extend onto a bright, smooth, thick yellow/orange-gold curved/straightish arrow-like path that continues to the right: a single bold yellow line with a thick outline-like look (solid, high-contrast) running nearly horizontally across the middle-right, ending in a large “X” mark at the far right. The X is a chunky yellow cross with dark charcoal outline and radiating yellow accent lines or bursts around it, like a highlighted target/forbidden/goal symbol. The arrow’s tip points into the X. 

Background maze: behind the main shortcut path is a large, semi-transparent/light-gray maze or winding pipeline network of rounded rectangular corridors and turns, drawn with thick pale gray/white/very light gray strokes and dashed inner trail segments, with several arrowheads along the maze indicating a complicated approved/slow route. The maze curves up and down, with dashed/dotted segments and multiple right-angle turns, with arrowheads at points showing direction (gray arrowheads integrated into the dashed path). The maze spans the center and right portions and the path loops around, with the direct yellow line cutting straight across the maze from left to right. The maze is faded so it doesn’t compete with the main yellow path and X. Color palette: dark charcoal outlines, white/very light gray fills, faint medium-light-gray maze/dashed path, bright yellow/orange-gold shortcut line and accents, transparent background (checkerboard indicates PNG transparency).
